messages:
Lena F.: Quick heads-up AstraMetrics sent INV-2056 and it's in AP with a hold. PDF has no PO and the vendor billed to Redwood, Inc. but this should be split to Redwood AI (intercompany). Also vendor applied a 10% withholding tax on the gross which we didn't expect.
Carlos M.: I pulled the file. They referenced PO 2024-ASTRA-02 in the email body but didn't attach it or print it. PO 2024-ASTRA-02 is for Redwood AI subscription only, not the implementation services on this invoice.
Elaine (AP): AP needs (a) PO attached to auto-match subscription lines, (b) documented approver for implementation services, and (c) confirmation re: tax withholding and correct payee/legal entity. Withholding will affect payment amount and requires tax docs.
Lena F.: Cost owner for the implementation line is Carlos. Can you approve the services and confirm whether Redwood AI should pay net of withholding or if vendor should reverse the withholding?
Carlos M.: I approve the implementation services. Approval text to attach: "Carlos M. approves AstraMetrics INV-2056 implementation services $4,500, GL=6401, cost center=AI-ENG. Charge to Redwood AI entity." As for withholding, vendor claims UK tax rule. We need VendorOps to provide vendor W-8/W-9 equivalent.
VendorOps Bot: Automated note: "Vendor record AstraMetrics Ltd missing tax certificate. Please request W-8/W-9. If withholding applies, AP will pay net and flag vendor for tax remediation"
Elaine (AP): OK. Carlos, please paste your exact approval note to the invoice record. Lena, can you attach the vendor email that references PO 2024-ASTRA-02 so we can match subscription lines once PO is found? Also upload any vendor tax documentation if available.
Lena F.: Done I uploaded Carlos's approval comment, attached vendor email screenshot, and flagged for VendorOps to request the tax certificate. I also added note: split lines -> subscription -> PO pending, implementation -> approved GL 6401 to Redwood AI.
finance-bot: Invoice INV-2056 status updated: "held-no-po" -> "manual-review". Approver assigned: Carlos M. Tax flag: withholding-detected.
Elaine (AP): Thanks. I'll hold net payment for now until tax docs come in and PO for subscription is attached. If VendorOps confirms vendor should be paid gross, AP will issue remittance and recover withholding via vendor claim. ETA hold review: 5 business days.
Carlos M.: I'll coordinate with VendorOps to get the W-8/W-9 and chase the vendor to reissue invoice with PO 2024-ASTRA-02 on the header and correct legal entity.
Lena F.: Noted. I'll update the vendor contact and loop back here when VendorOps confirms. Closing thread for now; will reopen if AP needs anything else.
